_provenance.capturedFrom: isolated throwaway `opencode serve` on 127.0.0.1:4791 with its own XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME (so the session-state plugin was NOT loaded and no live overlay was touched)
_provenance.how: config {"permission":"ask"} forces a real bash permission prompt; created two sessions in two different directories on the SAME serve, drove one with claude-haiku-4-5 to call the bash tool, captured GET /permission, the permission.asked SSE event, and the permission.replied SSE event after POST /permission/{requestID}/reply
_provenance.why: Closes two carried-forward Task 3 review gaps: (a) fetchPendingSnapshot assumed GET /permission returns an array of {id, sessionID} but that was never verified against a deployed server with a real pending prompt; (b) the .asked/.replied key asymmetry was only ever confirmed for question.*, never for permission.* -- that half rested on a one-time read of the bundled source.
_provenance.liveOverlayTripwire: listing of ~/.local/share/opencode/session-state.d was identical before and after the capture

directoryFilterMatrix._why: Negative control that was never run: proves ?directory= actually EXCLUDES prompts from other directories. If the param were ignored, a serve would seed other directories' sessions into its overlay, where they never receive events, and hasPending would then block eviction forever (permanent phantom `blocked`).
